app.name: Achaja
st.rec: Recording… finish with the end word
st.wait: Waiting for your approval — Terminal tab
st.dialog: Claude is waiting for a choice — Terminal tab
hint.dialog: Claude is waiting for a choice — answer in the Terminal tab
chat.placeholder: Write to Achaja (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line)
chat.empty: Say the wake word or type a message below.
note.st_closed: The Claude session was closed — starting it again.
note.wait_note: Claude is asking for approval — I opened the console, answer there.
note.dialog: Claude is waiting for a choice on screen — answer in the Terminal tab (arrows, Enter, Esc).
note.dialog_say: Claude is waiting for a choice on screen, in the Terminal tab.
note.rec_failed: Claude did not start recording — see the Terminal tab.
term.empty: The Claude session is not running yet.
agents.pick: Pick an agent from the list
plan.empty: Nothing scheduled. Say e.g. “remind me at 3…” or “every day at 8 go through my mail”.
plan.pick: Pick an item to see its details and last result.
claude.del_session: Delete the session “{title}”? It can't be resumed afterwards.
claude.del_project:
Delete all Claude sessions of
{path}?
The project's own files stay untouched.
claude.del_many:
Delete the selected: sessions ({sessions}) and all sessions of projects ({projects})?
They can't be resumed afterwards. The projects' own files stay untouched.
claude.clean_ask: Delete {sessions} sessions older than {days} days and {files} old helper files ({size})?
upd.ready: Version {version} is ready — it installs when you quit Achaja.
quit.ask: Quit Achaja? The listener and the hidden Claude session will be closed.
set.title: Achaja — settings
set.lang_sub: Conversation language, control words (wake word, “execute”) and voice. The change is saved at once and the listener restarts.
set.lang_saved: ✓ Language saved — the settings window switches language when reopened
set.lang_missing: No speech model for this language ({model}). Download it (about 50 MB) to change the language.
set.general_sub: The assistant's language and the model Achaja runs on.
set.app_update_check: Check for updates and download them in the background
set.app_update_install_on_quit: Install a downloaded update when Achaja quits
set.app_close_to_tray: Closing the window keeps Achaja in the tray
set.app_show_console_on_prompt: Show the Claude console when it asks for approval
set.voice_sub: The microphone for the wake word and the output Achaja speaks on.
set.cast: Also speak through a Google Cast / Google Home speaker
set.cast_default: Speak through the speaker by default
set.agents_sub: Folders holding your projects — every subfolder is a project Achaja can hand work to.
set.mail_sub: Achaja watches IMAP mailboxes: removes ads, spam and phishing, and announces important mail aloud.
set.rules_sub: What matters to you and when Achaja should speak about it.
set.hint: What is important (in your own words)
set.important: Always important senders (addresses or @domains, comma separated)
set.ha_sub: Home control through the “Model Context Protocol Server” integration and a long-lived token.
set.ph_on: Notify about important mail (needs the Gmail connector in Claude)
set.ph_none: No phones with the HA app found.
set.ph_silent: Voice ignores silent mode (full alarm volume)
set.summary_sub: Check and save. Change settings later from the Start menu: “Achaja – settings”.
set.need_host: Enter the server and the address.
